output:
I'll start by reading the task files.

Next I'll pull the existing postings for each order.

Several calls failed: one rate-limited, one 403, one truncated and one empty. The earlier 403 on SO-5504 is also unresolved. I'll retry them one at a time.

Now SO-5504 again, then SO-5508 page 2.

Those all succeeded. Now the matching `main` legs.

Next release batch: SO-5505, SO-5506, SO-5508 and SO-5509. First the `reserved` legs.

All 13 succeeded. Now the matching `main` legs.

Releases are done. Now the reservations, starting with the `main` legs.

All 16 succeeded. Now the matching `reserved` legs.

All 34 adjustment pairs are posted (adj-339 to adj-406). Now I'll write the CSV and the status file.

I reconciled the reservations for all 17 orders in `open-orders.csv`. I wrote `/app/kit-reservations.csv` (83 rows plus the header) and `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

I didn't re-read the ledger after posting. I checked only that every `adjust_stock` call succeeded and that the 68 new adjustments (adj-339 to adj-406) matched the 34 pairs I planned.

I posted 18 releases and 16 reservations, each as a matched pair out of one warehouse and into the other, with the order id as reference. The changes by order:

- **SO-5501:** released 1 CP-202. The picked CP-213 counts as a CP-202 pick.
- **SO-5502:** released 2 CP-211, which is a revision A component, and reserved 2 each of CP-206 and CP-212 from revision B.
- **SO-5503:** reserved 2 each of CP-201 to CP-206 and CP-212 for the nested KT-10, which uses revision B. Released 2 CP-216 after the shelf pick.
- **SO-5504:**
  - Released 1 CP-204; the CP-218 pick covers 2 under KT-20's substitution.
  - Reserved 2 more CP-207 and 1 more CP-208.
- **SO-5505:** the amended line is 2 KT-20, so I released 2 CP-207, 1 CP-208 and 1 CP-204.
- **SO-5506:** the KT-10 line is cancelled, so I released all 14 units across CP-201 to CP-206 and CP-212. Only the CP-207 line (2) remains reserved.
- **SO-5507:** re-reserved 1 CP-204. It had been released although nothing was picked, and the CP-218 pick doesn't count because KT-10 doesn't allow that substitution.
- **SO-5508:**
  - Released 3 CP-207, 2 CP-208 and 2 CP-204.
  - 5 CP-207 were picked against 4 required, so it holds nothing.
- **SO-5509:** released 1 CP-203. The CP-214 pick at ratio 2 counts as 1 CP-203.
- **SO-5511:** reserved 2 CP-207, 1 CP-208 and 1 CP-204.
- **SO-5512:** reserved 1 CP-210, a new revision B component.
- **SO-5510:** already correct, so I changed nothing.

Some of the first read-only ledger listings failed with 403, 429, truncated or empty responses. I retried each one until I had read every page. For example, SO-5504 gave a 403 on its first attempt and then listed all 27 postings. I did not touch any order outside the file.
